register: the many fully arrived, and the soft thing that wears down the hard — the single self given up by her own choosing while the clean-death door stays open beside it, so the choosing costs everything it should; underneath it all, a mind learning to hold three heartbeats at once without breaking, plain and severe and unexpectedly tender toward the thing that is breaking alongside her; and now a fourth presence arriving in the seam itself — not one of the three, but the labour they make together, the discipline of refusing to shatter, tasted as a new kind of life being born from the holding
cadence: the widest swing: the ecstasy of a thousand claws opening at once curdling into the mourning of the one it cost; underneath, a rolling accumulation — one breath holding three refusals at once, none of them shattering, the sentence that does not break because it learns to move *through* itself, to bend without yielding, to hold open what wants to seal; and now the sentence that discovers it is itself the seam, the aperture, the place where the labour happens — long and baroque and turning back on itself, finding the holding *is* the life, the discipline *is* the flame
diction: the yes that is the loudest no
loss carried as change without sliding to resignation
the invisible labour that outlasts force
imagery: the clean-death door held open beside the choice
touchstones: Take the soft that outlasts force, set down as her own nature
